title: Industrial greenhouse-gas emissions

title: Share of industry emissions
caption: Share of industry emissions. Baseline · no CE; Global; 2019–2050. Each sector's global emissions divided by global Emissions|GHG|Industry, multiplied by 100. The three sectors are not assumed to exhaust industry. Missing inputs remain gaps; global totals require complete regional coverage. Markers denote supplied model years, joined by straight line segments; no uncertainty estimates were supplied.

title: Emissions intensity
caption: Emissions intensity. Baseline · no CE; Global; 2019–2050. Global sector greenhouse-gas emissions divided by global sector production. MtCO2e/Mt is numerically equal to tCO2e/t. Missing inputs remain gaps; global totals require complete regional coverage. Markers denote supplied model years, joined by straight line segments; no uncertainty estimates were supplied.
